scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a dist -n mantis-helper-chrome-{version}.zip -o && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a dist -n mantis-helper-firefox-{version}.zip -o
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 . && node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext lint -s dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
